table.description: ServiceNow ticket table: incident, change_request, problem or sc_task (catalog task).

record_id.description: Record sys_id (32 hex characters) or record number, for example INC0010001 or CHG0030002.

fields.description: Fields to change keyed by column name using raw values, for example {"state": "6", "close_code": "Solved (Permanently)", "close_notes": "..."} or {"assigned_to": "<user sys_id or user_name>"}. State values differ per table and instance; read the record with display_value=all first if unsure.
